title: Data and code for a critical review of column generation and branch-and-price acceleration

creators.name: Xinran Yang
creators.affiliation: School of Management and Engineering, Capital University of Economics and Business, China

description: Coded inventory of 130 method variants (63 traditional, 67 learning-guided) from all 88 core or supporting study families (80 core, 8 supporting), drawn from a 100-family full-text frame. Includes the v1.10 adjudication record, family-level sensitivity table, Figure 3 and Figure A.1 data, Table 4 source locators and recheck notes, Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 with the supplied-upper-bound column, retained search records and the 16 October OpenAlex/arXiv coverage check, codebook, 27-case independent re-coding pack with agreement code, unchanged release 1.2 evidence tables, and figure sources. This is a bounded critical sample, not an exhaustive census or a reproduction of the source papers' solver experiments. No independent human re-coding has been completed.
